ar.title: تجري الرياح
ar.body:
ما كل ما يتمنى المرء يدركه
تجري الرياح بما لا تشتهي السفن

en.title: The Winds Blow
en.body:
Not all that a man longs for will he reach;
the winds blow where the ships would never wish.

de.title: Die Winde wehen
de.body:
Nicht alles, was der Mensch sich wünscht, erreicht er;
die Winde wehen, wie es die Schiffe nicht begehren.

tr.title: Rüzgârlar Eser
tr.body:
İnsan her dilediğine ulaşamaz;
rüzgârlar, gemilerin istemediği yönde eser.
